frames.on_screen:
Title: The Emotional Cycle of Change

Y-axis: Emotional stage (divided horizontally by dashed line into Optimism above and Pessimism below)
X-axis: Time

Stages along curve:
- Stage 1: Uninformed Optimism (top left)
- Stage 2: Informed Pessimism (descending slope crossing into Pessimism)
- Stage 3: Valley of Despair (bottom trough, with vertical dashed line)
- Stage 4: Informed Optimism (ascending slope crossing back into Optimism)
- Stage 5: Success & Fulfillment (top right peak)

Bottom labels along X-axis around Stage 3 dashed line:
- Left arrow: "Quit & repeat phases 1-3"
- Right arrow: "Push through t..." [partially obscured by speaker overlay]
frames.not_in_transcript: Stage 5 label: "Stage 5: Success & Fulfillment"; dashed threshold dividing Optimism and Pessimism; bottom directional arrows "Quit & repeat phases 1-3" and "Push through t...".
